Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* Modified and verified for Y2k...Sobha....06/99 */
/*-- The GLOBAL variables global.day and global.month gets populated of WHEN-NEW-ITEM-INSTANCE
 of property class CAL_FLDS --*/
DECLARE
 curmonth varchar2(6) ;
 month varchar2(10) ;
BEGIN
 :global.position:=:system.cursor_item;
 :global.drive_date := :global.day||:global.month ;
 go_block('ddate') ; 
 month := to_char(to_date(:global.drive_date,'DDMMYYYY'),'MONTH') ;
 :ddate.ddate := initcap(month)||' '||ltrim(substr(:global.drive_date,1,2),'0')||', '||substr(:global.drive_date,5,4) ;
 :ddate.week_day := to_char(to_date(:global.drive_date,'DDMMYYYY'),'DY') ;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 go_block('drives') ; 
 clear_block(no_validate);
 execute_query ;
 :system.message_level := 0;
END;

DECLARE
 v_count number:=0;
BEGIN

 If :view_mode_select.s_option='ALL' then
 null;

/*-------------------------------------------
This trigger attempts to minimize database access by following means :
 if scroll is for one month, the information for the existing two months in the calendar are just
 shifted to the proper block by using COPY_BLOCK_INFO. Database is accessed to decide status
 for one month only.
 if scroll is for two months, the information for the existing one month in the calendar is just
 shifted to the proper block by using COPY_BLOCK_INFO. Database is accessed to decide status
 for the other two months.
 If scroll is greater than or equal to three months, database is accessed for all three months.

 Also, if resource view mode is changed, database has to be accessed for all three months.
-----------------------------------------------*/

declare
 curmonth varchar2(6) ;
 scroll_months number ;
 status_string varchar2(2000) ;
 err_flag varchar2(1) ;
 err_msg varchar2(200) ;
begin
 if NVL(length(:change_view_opt.start_yr_change), 0) != 4 or :change_view_opt.start_mon_change is null then
 show_error('11118') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;

 :view_mode_select.start_mon := :change_view_opt.start_mon_change ;
 :view_mode_select.start_yr := :change_view_opt.start_yr_change ;

 curmonth := :view_mode_select.start_mon||:view_mode_select.start_yr ;

 scroll_months := months_between(to_date('01'||curmonth,'DDMMYYYY'),to_date('01'||:month1,'DDMMYYYY'));

 if :change_view_opt.resource_view_change != :view_mode_select.resource_view_mode then
 :view_mode_select.resource_view_mode := :change_view_opt.resource_view_change ;
 populate_cal_days('CAL_BLK1',curmonth) ;
 check_package_failure ;
 curmonth := to_char(add_months(to_date('01'||curmonth,'DDMMYYYY'),1),'MMYYYY');
 populate_cal_days('CAL_BLK2',curmonth) ;
 check_package_failure ;
 curmonth := to_char(add_months(to_date('01'||curmonth,'DDMMYYYY'),1),'MMYYYY');
 populate_cal_days('CAL_BLK3',curmonth) ;
 check_package_failure ;
 set_all_color ;
 check_package_failure ;
 common_scroll_function ;
 check_package_failure ;
 else

 if scroll_months >= 3 or scroll_months <= -3 then
 populate_cal_days('CAL_BLK1',curmonth) ; 
 check_package_failure ;
 curmonth := to_char(add_months(to_date('01'||curmonth,'DDMMYYYY'),1),'MMYYYY');
 populate_cal_days('CAL_BLK2',curmonth) ;
 check_package_failure ;
 curmonth := to_char(add_months(to_date('01'||curmonth,'DDMMYYYY'),1),'MMYYYY');
 populate_cal_days('CAL_BLK3',curmonth) ;
 check_package_failure ;
 set_all_color ;
 check_package_failure ;
 common_scroll_function ;
 check_package_failure ;

 elsif scroll_months = 1 then

 go_item('scroll_back') ; execute_trigger('WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED') ; check_package_failure ;

 elsif scroll_months = 2 then

 copy_block_info('cal_blk1','cal_blk3') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 populate_cal_days('cal_blk2', to_char(add_months(to_date('01'||curmonth,'DDMMYYYY'),1),'MMYYYY'));
 check_package_failure ;
 populate_cal_days('cal_blk3', to_char(add_months(to_date('01'||curmonth,'DDMMYYYY'),2),'MMYYYY'));
 check_package_failure ;
 don_mcal_common.decide_day_status( to_date('01'||:month2,'DDMMYYYY'),
 last_day(to_date('01'||:month3,'DDMMYYYY')),
 :global.chapter_id,
 :view_mode_select.resource_view_mode,
 status_string,
 err_flag,
 err_msg ) ;
 if err_flag = 'Y' then
 message('Error in stored program unit DECIDE_DAY_STATUS');
 message(err_msg) ;
 pause ;
 raise form_trigger_failure ;
 end if ;
 check_package_failure ;
 :global.start_pos := '1' ;
 decode_status_string('cal_blk2',:month2,status_string) ;
 decode_status_string('cal_blk3',:month3,status_string) ;
 :global.start_pos := '1' ;

 common_scroll_function ;
 check_package_failure ;

 elsif scroll_months = -1 then

 go_item('scroll_back') ; execute_trigger('WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED') ; check_package_failure ;

 elsif scroll_months = -2 then

 copy_block_info('cal_blk3','cal_blk1') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 populate_cal_days('cal_blk1', curmonth);
 check_package_failure ;
 populate_cal_days('cal_blk2', to_char(add_months(to_date('01'||curmonth,'DDMMYYYY'),1),'MMYYYY'));
 check_package_failure ;
 don_mcal_common.decide_day_status( to_date('01'||:month1,'DDMMYYYY'),
 last_day(to_date('01'||:month2,'DDMMYYYY')),
 :global.chapter_id,
 :view_mode_select.resource_view_mode,
 status_string,
 err_flag,
 err_msg ) ;
 if err_flag = 'Y' then
 message('Error in stored program unit DECIDE_DAY_STATUS');

 pause ;
 raise form_trigger_failure ;
 end if ;
 check_package_failure ;

 :global.start_pos := '1' ;
 decode_status_string('cal_blk1',:month1,status_string) ;
 check_package_failure ;
 decode_status_string('cal_blk2',:month2,status_string) ;
 check_package_failure ;
 :global.start_pos := '1' ;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* Modified and verified for Y2k...Sobha....06/99 */
PROCEDURE populate_cal_days (curblk in VARCHAR2,yearmonth in VARCHAR2)IS
 FirstItemName varchar(60) ;
 Day VARCHAR2(3) ;
 TotDays number ;
 Counter number ;
 PrevItemName varchar2(80) ;
 FirstDay number(2);
 goal number(6) ;
 pdraw number(6) ;
BEGIN

/*------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 This program unit populates the calendar. Explanation of inputs are :

 curblk : Block name which will be populated. Right now, only CAL_BLK1, CAL_BLK2 and 
 CAL_BLK3 are valid values.
 yearmonth : Month and year for which this block will be populated. yearmonth SHOULD BE 
 IN 'MMYYYY' format
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

 go_block(curblk) ;
 clear_block ;
 init_properties(curblk) ;

 /* Get the first day of the month */
 Day := to_char(to_date('01'||yearmonth,'DDMMYYYY'),'DY') ;

 /* Get total number of days in the month */
 TotDays := to_number(to_char(last_day(to_date('01'||yearmonth,'DDMMYYYY')),'DD')) ;

 /* Go to the first item */
 FirstItemName := curblk||'.'||get_block_property(curblk,FIRST_ITEM);
 go_item(FirstItemName) ;
 if form_failure then
 message('Failed to go to first item,contact IS') ;
 end if ;


 /* Decide which item holds the first day of the month */
 if Day = 'SUN' then FirstDay := 1 ;
 elsif Day = 'MON' then FirstDay := 2 ;
 elsif Day = 'TUE' then FirstDay := 3 ;
 elsif Day = 'WED' then FirstDay := 4 ;
 elsif Day = 'THU' then FirstDay := 5 ;
 elsif Day = 'FRI' then FirstDay := 6 ;
 elsif Day = 'SAT' then FirstDay := 7 ;
 end if ;

 Counter := 1 ;
 /* moving the cursor to the required position */

 while Counter < FirstDay loop
 next_item ;
 Counter := Counter + 1 ;
 end loop ;

 Counter := 1 ;

 while Counter <= TotDays loop
 copy(to_char(Counter),:system.cursor_item) ;
 next_item ;
 Counter := Counter + 1 ;
 end loop ;
 
 /* Do not allow navigation to items which are not
 relevant to the current month */
 go_block(curblk) ;
 Counter := 1 ;
 go_item(FirstItemName) ;

/* temporarily commented to allow navigation

 while Counter <= 35 loop
 if :system.cursor_value is null
 then
 PrevItemName := :system.cursor_item ;
 next_item ;
 set_item_property(PrevItemName,NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_FALSE) ;
 else
 next_item ;
 end if ;
 Counter := Counter + 1 ;
 end loop ;
*/

 /* Do not allow navigation--- till here */

 if upper(curblk) = 'CAL_BLK1' then
 :month1 := yearmonth ;
 :monthname1 := rtrim(to_char(to_date('01'||yearmonth,'DDMMYYYY'),'MONTH'))||' '||
 to_char(to_date('01'||yearmonth,'DDMMYYYY'),'YYYY');
 populate_goal(:month1,goal,pdraw) ;
 :monthly_goal1 := goal ;
 :booked1 := pdraw ;
 elsif upper(curblk) = 'CAL_BLK2' then
 :month2 := yearmonth ;
 :monthname2 := rtrim(to_char(to_date('01'||yearmonth,'DDMMYYYY'),'MONTH'))||' '||
 to_char(to_date('01'||yearmonth,'DDMMYYYY'),'YYYY');
 populate_goal(:month2,goal,pdraw) ;
 :monthly_goal2 := goal ;
 :booked2 := pdraw ;
 elsif upper(curblk) = 'CAL_BLK3' then
 :month3 := yearmonth ;
 :monthname3 := rtrim(to_char(to_date('01'||yearmonth,'DDMMYYYY'),'MONTH'))||' '||
 to_char(to_date('01'||yearmonth,'DDMMYYYY'),'YYYY');
 populate_goal(:month3,goal,pdraw) ;
 :monthly_goal3 := goal ;
 :booked3 := pdraw ;
 end if ;

END;

PROCEDURE copy_block_info (dest_blk in varchar2,src_blk in varchar2) IS
 visual_attrib_src varchar2(80) ;
 src_value varchar2(2) ;
 temp_item_src varchar2(80) ;
 temp_item_dest varchar2(80) ;
 enterable_src varchar2(80) ;
 navigable_src varchar2(80) ;
BEGIN

/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 This program unit copies the values of all items with their properties from src_blk to
 dest_blk. src_blk and dest_blk are actual block names (which should be among CAL_BLK1,
 CAL_BLK2 and CAL_BLK3. This program unit is used whenever scroll is less than three months.
 Purpose of this is to minimize database access, whenever possible.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
 go_block(dest_blk) ;
 init_properties(dest_blk) ;
 :item_dest := dest_blk||'.'||get_block_property(dest_blk,FIRST_ITEM) ;
 :item_src:= src_blk||'.'||get_block_property(src_blk,FIRST_ITEM) ;

 loop
 visual_attrib_src := get_item_property(:item_src,VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE) ;

 src_value := name_in(name_in('item_src')) ;
 copy(src_value,name_in('item_dest')) ;

 if src_value is null then
 set_item_property(:item_dest,NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 end if ;

 set_item_property(:item_dest,VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,visual_attrib_src);

 temp_item_dest := get_item_property(:item_dest,NEXTITEM) ;
 temp_item_src := get_item_property(:item_src,NEXTITEM) ;

 if temp_item_src is null then
 exit ;
 end if ;

 :item_dest:= dest_blk||'.'||temp_item_dest ;
 :item_src := src_blk||'.'||temp_item_src ;

 end loop ; 

/*-- Change the displayed month names --*/
 if dest_blk = 'cal_blk1' then
 :item_dest := 'monthname1' ;
 elsif dest_blk = 'cal_blk2' then
 :item_dest := 'monthname2' ;
 elsif dest_blk = 'cal_blk3' then
 :item_dest := 'monthname3' ;
 end if ;

 if src_blk = 'cal_blk1' then
 :item_src := 'monthname1' ;
 elsif src_blk = 'cal_blk2' then
 :item_src := 'monthname2' ;
 elsif src_blk = 'cal_blk3' then
 :item_src := 'monthname3' ;
 end if ;

 copy( name_in(name_in('item_src')) ,name_in('item_dest')) ;

/*-- Change the month fields on null canvas --*/
 if dest_blk = 'cal_blk1' then
 :item_dest := 'month1' ;
 elsif dest_blk = 'cal_blk2' then
 :item_dest := 'month2' ;
 elsif dest_blk = 'cal_blk3' then
 :item_dest := 'month3' ;
 end if ;

 if src_blk = 'cal_blk1' then
 :item_src := 'month1' ;
 elsif src_blk = 'cal_blk2' then
 :item_src := 'month2' ;
 elsif src_blk = 'cal_blk3' then

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* Modified and verified for Y2k...Sobha...o6/99 */
PROCEDURE decode_status_string (curblk in varchar2,curmonth in varchar2,status_string in varchar2) IS
 status varchar2(5) ;
 curitm varchar2(80) ;
 counter number := 0; 
 next_delim_pos number ;
 start_pos number := 1 ;
 recruiter_drive_flag varchar2(1) ;
 caldate date ; 
BEGIN
/*---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 This program decodes the status string returned by the DECIDE_DAY_STATUS stored program unit.
 Format of the string is as follows :
 10 characters of date field in 'MM-DD-YYYY' format followed by status value. ':' is used
 as delimiter.
 NOTE : If you are calling this function just once, then set GLOBAL.start_pos to '1' before the
 call. If you are calling this function more than once in a single scroll, which implies
 that you are scrolling by more than one month, then set GLOBAL.start_pos to '1' before the
 first call
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/

 start_pos := to_number(:global.start_pos) ;

 go_block(curblk) ;
 curitm := curblk||'.'||Get_Block_Property( curblk, FIRST_ITEM );
 go_item(curitm) ;

 while nvl(:system.cursor_value,'*') != '1' loop
 next_item ;
 end loop ;

 loop
 next_delim_pos := instr(status_string,':',start_pos,1) ;
 caldate := to_date(substr(status_string,start_pos,10),'MM-DD-YYYY') ;
 recruiter_drive_flag := substr(status_string,start_pos+10,1) ;

 status := substr(status_string,start_pos+11,next_delim_pos-start_pos-11) ;
 start_pos := next_delim_pos + 1 ;

 if status = 'OPEN' then
 if recruiter_drive_flag = 'Y' then
 set_item_property(:system.cursor_item,VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'GREEN_ATTR_UNDLN') ;
 else
 set_item_property(:system.cursor_item,VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'GREEN_ATTR') ;
 end if ;
 elsif status = 'LIMIT' then
 if recruiter_drive_flag = 'Y' then
 set_item_property(:system.cursor_item,VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'YELLOW_ATTR_UNDLN') ;
 else
 set_item_property(:system.cursor_item,VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'YELLOW_ATTR') ;
 end if ;
 elsif status = 'BOOKD' then
 if recruiter_drive_flag = 'Y' then
 set_item_property(:system.cursor_item,VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'RED_ATTR_UNDLN') ;
 else
 set_item_property(:system.cursor_item,VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'RED_ATTR') ;
 end if ;
 elsif status = 'CLOSD' then
 if recruiter_drive_flag = 'Y' then
 set_item_property(:system.cursor_item,VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'BLUE_ATTR_UNDLN') ;
 else
 set_item_property(:system.cursor_item,VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'BLUE_ATTR') ;
 end if ;
 else
 message('Invalid status on '||to_char(caldate,'MM-DD-RR')) ;
 end if ;
 
 if caldate = last_day(to_date('01'||curmonth,'DDMMYYYY')) then
 exit ;
 else
 next_item ;
 end if ;
 end loop ;

 :global.start_pos := ltrim(rtrim(to_char(next_delim_pos+1))) ;
END;

PROCEDURE color_setting_booked(curblk in varchar2,pl_inst in varchar2,pl_start_date in date,
 pl_end_date in date) IS

 CURSOR goal_act is select a.goal_start_date SD,a.goal_count GC,sum(b.credit_count) CC,
 (sum(b.credit_count)/a.goal_count)*100 PER from goals a,
 donations b where a.goal_start_date between pl_start_date and pl_end_date and 
 a.goal_custodian=pl_inst and b.coll_date=a.goal_start_date group by a.goal_start_date ,
 a.goal_count;


 CURSOR goal_draw is select a.goal_start_date SD,a.goal_count GC,sum(b.projected_draw) CC,
 (sum(b.projected_draw)/a.goal_count)*100 PER from goals a,
 drives b where a.goal_start_date between pl_start_date and pl_end_date and
 a.goal_custodian='WDLY' and b.drive_date=a.goal_start_date
 group by a.goal_start_date , a.goal_count;

 curitm varchar2(20);
 item_day varchar2(2);
 v_count number;
 Procedure set_pointer_to_1 is
 begin
 go_block(curblk) ;
 curitm := curblk||'.'||Get_Block_Property( curblk, FIRST_ITEM );
 go_item(curitm) ;
 while nvl(:system.cursor_value,'*') != '1' loop
 next_item ;
 end loop ;
 End set_pointer_to_1;

BEGIN
 
 go_block(curblk) ;
 curitm := curblk||'.'||Get_Block_Property( curblk, FIRST_ITEM );
 go_item(curitm) ;

 set_pointer_to_1;

 ---message(curblk||' Ins='||pl_inst||'SD='||to_char(pl_start_date)||'End='||to_char(pl_end_date));pause;

 if goal_draw%isopen then
 close goal_draw;
 end if;
 
 FOR goal_rec IN goal_draw loop
 
 item_day:=to_char(goal_rec.SD,'DD');
 set_pointer_to_1;
 While nvl(:system.cursor_value,'*')!='*' loop
 If to_number(item_day)=to_number(:system.cursor_value) then 
 if goal_rec.per>=100 then
 set_item_property(:system.cursor_item,VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'RED_ATTR');
 elsif goal_rec.per between 90 and 99 then
 set_item_property(:system.cursor_item,VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'YELLOW_ATTR');
 elsif goal_rec.per < 90 then
 set_item_property(:system.cursor_item,VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'GREEN_ATTR');
 else 
 set_item_property(:system.cursor_item,VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'GREEN_ATTR');
 end if;
 exit;
 end if;
 next_item;
 end loop;
 END LOOP;

--- to check the uncolored date ---
 
 set_pointer_to_1;
 WHILE (:system.cursor_value is not null ) LOOP 
 if get_item_property(:system.cursor_item,VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE) not in
 ('GREEN_ATTR','RED_ATTR','YELLOW_ATTR') then
 set_item_property(:system.cursor_item,VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'GREEN_ATTR');
 end if;
 next_item;

 END LOOP; 
 
EXCEPTION when others then
 message(sqlerrm);
 check_package_failure;
End color_setting_booked;

declare
 procedure format_error is
 temp_format varchar2(100);
 temp_pos number;
 begin
 temp_format := upper(GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK));
 -- remove FM or FX format prefix
 if substr(temp_format,1,2) in ('FX','FM') then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,3);
 end if;
 -- remove double quotes and change 0 to 9
 temp_format := translate(temp_format,'0"','9');
 -- change HH24 to HH
 temp_pos := instr(temp_format,'HH24');
 if temp_pos != 0 then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,temp_pos-1)||'HH'||
 substr(temp_format,temp_pos + 4);
 end if;
 -- change multiple RR to YY
 loop
 temp_pos := instr(temp_format,'RR');
 exit when temp_pos = 0;
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,temp_pos-1)||'YY'||
 substr(temp_format,temp_pos + 2);
 end loop;
 show_error('0022',temp_format );
 check_package_failure;
 end;
